_comment: Ignore rules for scan-ptbr.py — suppress reviewed/unfixable matches.
_usage: ignoreFiles:         skip entire files (relative path from project root)
ignoreLines:         skip specific line numbers in a file
ignoreWords:        skip a word in a specific file
ignoreWordsGlobal:  skip a word across all files
_tips: Run with --summary first to see counts, then add ignores incrementally.
Use --include-was to also see intentional 'was' annotation comments.
Use --strict to disable all auto-filtering (identical words + was annotations).
Use --json --save to export a machine-readable report.
